notes.title: Development update on upcoming projects
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a while since the last announcement, so here's an update on how things are. In the last announcement, I mentioned that two VN projects were already in the works. Development on both is still ongoing. Below is a bit more information on each one.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cold Verdict 3[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This will be the third and final part in the Cold Verdict series. (PS: The first Cold Verdict is currently on a discount at the time of this update, so might be a good time to get it if you haven't yet)[/p][p][/p][p]Cold Verdict 3 will be roughly the same length as the first two instalments and will be priced about the same. All of the story points and questions from the previous two games should be concluded and resolved in this one. At the moment I'm aiming to release it sometime near the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/a264ad649174340d1c7f0db783638df2ae6f4391.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Post-apocalyptic sci-fi project that currently still has no definite name[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A lot more work has been done on this one over the last few months. As mentioned in the last update, this one will be a bigger game than Cold Verdict 3 and at least as long as Interim Crossroads. This story will involve relationship building, choices with consequences, character stats to keep track of, multiple endings, as well as a choice to play as either a male or a female main character. The choice to play as male or female is not just cosmetic here. The intention is to provide a somewhat different experience, where characters will treat you differently depending on whether you're male or female. This means some dialogues will differ, some scenes, romance options, and even some of the endings. [/p][p][/p][p]There's no definite title for this project yet, but this will come later on in development. The release date for this one will most likely be in early 2026, so it should hopefully not be a long time after Cold Verdict 3 release when this one will also be out. Also keep a look out for more development updates in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, I hope you enjoy some screenshots below from this project.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/4b05c0bffc1e6fdad6a930cc3f35be9c193aa387.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Projects for 2025
notes.content:
Hi all!

I would like to share some information on the new projects that are planned for this year and on which the development is already ongoing. There are two projects planned for this year (depending on the development time, one might be pushed back onto early 2026, but that remains to be seen).

The first one, the shorter project, is as was mentioned before, the final 3rd part to Cold Verdict series which will serve as a conclusion to the story. Another familiar face from the first game will now return in this one...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/4bcff9b719529106888b1d32bf57596e2fde68e5.jpg[/img]

The second project, which will be longer and bigger, is going to be set in a post-apocalyptic near future world, mainly taking place inside an underground sanctuary. We'll play the role of a volunteer for a gene therapy experiment to make humans able to survive in the new world. Similarly to Interim Crossroads, this VN will have some character stats to keep track of, which will unlock some new options during the in-game choices. Another major element in the story-telling here is that we'll get a choice of our main character being male or female at the start, and this will have an effect on how others will treat you, as well as the available romance options, and even some endings will be possible only with either male or female.
For now there's no title for this project, but once there is a decision on that, I'll mention it in one of the updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/a1e9d79695945dd0541c9e8da11a1f8e6067756a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/17584d31eee61e0f586f9018f314cadaf423ae48.jpg[/img]

Thank you for the support! Let's hope this year will prove to be a positive year on all fronts!

notes.title: Cold Verdict sequel in the works
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Wanted to make an announcement that Cold Verdict 2 has already been in the works for some time and will be a direct sequel to the first, following a new set events a few months after the events of the first game in order to shed more light on what exactly is going on and why. It will be roughly just as long as the first game and will involve similar gameplay and pacing, being an interactive story with some choices coming up, either relating to dialogue and trust-building or relating to choices that alter story events.

notes.title: Holiday with Gwen - Development Update 2
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

It's been a while since the last update on the current game. If you recall, this new game project takes place in the Snares of Ruin universe. Hank and Gwen are on a special mission in an exotic country, but there are plenty of chances to do fun activities and develop romance too. The game is a visual novel mainly with some dialogue choices.

The development is still going. It was slower than I hoped in the last few months, but it is still going. For this reason, the game is unlikely to be ready this summer as originally expected, but aiming to have it ready sometime this autumn. The exact date will be confirmed later.

Thank you all for the continuous support, comments and reviews!

Here are a couple of new screenshots from the game.

notes.title: Next project development update 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A big thanks for the support and feedback relating to 'Cold Verdict' and 'Pegasus: Broken Wings', both of which came out late last year. In this update I wanted to shed some light on the next project I am currently working on. I already briefly mentioned this one in one of the past updates, so some of you will already know what I'm talking about.

So this project will be a visual novel as well, in the same gameplay style as 'Cold Verdict', but in terms of story and genre entirely different. In fact it will take place in the 'Snares of Ruin' universe and will follow our two main protagonists - Hank and Gwen. The two detectives are sent abroad to an exotic country for a special assignment. But of course, while there, they are also going to enjoy themselves - visiting the beach, the swimming pool, the historical town areas, fancy cafes, and so on. There is of course going to be a hefty amount of romance here, and since the only romantic interest here is Gwen, there will be plenty of scenes (in some previous games, having multiple possible romantic interests, it meant players would only experience a small portion of them, so each romantic interest had a small number of them).

So there will be some detective work and action scenes and also plenty of down time, romance, and fun.

As with 'Cold Verdict', all the 3D images will be done in Daz3D. Here are a couple of screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/bb4a21fcd274c08ad45c6f748c5af18bb219faa6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41559434/920dfed053711825dbfef8543384d2f6ccc0d1fe.png[/img]

Thanks again for all the support and stay tuned for further updates!
